question: In what forms do the prepared substances grant all forms of ritual success?
premises: Substances can be prepared in different forms
Pill, decoction, and ash are varieties
inference: As pills, decoctions, or ashes, these preparations grant all forms of success.
uncertainties: Agreement between singular guṭikā and plural nikhilasiddhidāyinyaḥ is syntactically loose
plain_english: In the forms of pill, decoction, or ash, these preparations grant all kinds of success.
